title: Rational powers-of-pi volumes of polarized absolutely rigid linear submanifolds in Abelian-differential strata
source_title: Variation of Hodge structure and enumerating tilings of surfaces by triangles and squares
author: Vincent Koziarz; Duc-Manh Nguyen
difficulty_reason: Kollár's cited curvature-current theorem applies after a suitable extension of the tautological line bundle; it does not itself construct that extension for the noncompact linear submanifold. The author first proves the exact Hermitian volume-to-curvature identity, then constructs a ramified cover and a graph modification followed by resolution that place the line subbundle in the required setting. The degree bookkeeping and integral characteristic class then close the printed rational-power-of-pi volume conclusion.

proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Independent Theorem4.1 for complex algebraic linear submanifolds of strata of translation surfaces that are polarized and transverse to the kernel foliation. Volume is exactly the Hermitian local-system measure of Section3, not an unqualified lattice-counting measure. Complete finite-cover/canonical-extension/tautological-line graph-resolution core and pointwise curvature calculation retained. Deligne–Schmid canonical extensions, resolution of singularities and Kollár curvature-current theorem are explicit cited existing research foundations. No conjectural identity with the incidence compactification line bundle from Remark4.3, and no noncompact global lattice-counting conclusion from sketch Lemma5.1 is selected. Bounded scalar discrepancy between3.1 pullback display and its following integral does not affect the explicitly computed rational-times-pi factor or the selected rationality statement.
